missed.maker: Texas Instruments (JLCPCB label 'Texas Instruments'); S1 Texas Instruments
missed.why: Family not considered (external ADC option). Data sheet SLAS492B, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads7886.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:35:11Z. 12-bit SAR, 1 MSPS at 20 MHz SCLK. VDD 2.35 to 5.25 V, and VDD is the reference: full-scale span 0 V to VDD, so it covers 0.33 to 2.97 V from the 3.3 V rail. The input is sampled on the falling edge of CS, so the coprocessor sets each sample instant. Aperture delay 5 ns typ; no aperture jitter is stated. SINAD 69 dB min at VDD 2.35 to 3.6 V and fIN 100 kHz, over -40 to 125 degC, which is 11.2 bits ENOB. SDO swings to VDD, so the output is at 3.3 V logic. Digital inputs are rated to 5.25 V whatever VDD is. Pinout and frame match the shortlisted ADCS7476: pin 1 VDD, 2 GND, 3 VIN, 4 SCLK, 5 SDO, 6 CS, SOT-23-6. The frame is 4 leading zeros and 12 bits MSB first over 16 SCLK (ADCS7476 SNAS192G, re-read at https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/adcs7476.pdf, 2026-09-28T15:35:15Z). That makes it a rule-5 alternate for the rank-1 ADCS7476 in the same circuit and firmware. Stock and status: JLCPCB stockCount 1,530, canPresaleNumber 1,515, extended library, 3.714 USD at 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C2669886, 2026-09-28T15:33:20Z). Digi-Key 185, Active, lead 16 weeks (api.digikey.com productdetails ADS7886SBDBVR, 2026-09-28T15:34:26Z). The TI product page shows ADS7886 ACTIVE, orderable ADS7886SBDBVR ACTIVE (https://www.ti.com/product/ADS7886, 2026-09-28T15:40:18Z). First data sheet revision September 2005. Gate: 50 (5 boards x 2 placements, P2's basis, S4 minimum 50).

In P2's own jlcparts reference list, but neither shortlisted nor dropped. Reference option. Data sheet SBOS600F (REF20), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ref20.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:35:56Z. VREF 3.0 V, accuracy -0.05 % to +0.05 % at 25 degC. Temperature coefficient 8 ppm/degC max over -40 to 125 degC (box method). Line regulation 35 ppm/V max. Load regulation 20 ppm/mA max sourcing, output 0 to 20 mA. VIN is VREF + 0.02 V to 5.5 V at IL 0 mA. Dropout is 20 mV max (10 mV typ) and 600 mV max at 20 mA. So it runs from the 3.3 V rail at its 3.201 V low end (Research.md:283), and ADC_AVDD falls with that rail. Worst-case output, adding the data sheet limits over the full box: 3.0 V - 1.5 mV - 3.96 mV - line 0.19 mV - load 0.01 mV = 2.994 V. That is above the 2.97 V floor, with more margin than any shortlisted reference (REF3030 2.990 V, LM4040B 2.974 V, per P2). Supply current 430 uA max at 25 degC, 460 uA over temperature. Noise 12 ppm p-p (0.1 to 10 Hz) and 0.25 ppm/sqrt(Hz) at 100 Hz; the 10 Hz to 10 kHz integral is not stated. EN is tied to VIN (EN >= VIN - 0.7 V). A VBIAS output at VREF/2 is also present. SOT-23-5 (DDC). Stock and status: JLCPCB stockCount 4,610, canPresaleNumber 4,505, extended, 2.2183 USD at 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C528704, 2026-09-28T15:33:39Z). Digi-Key 5,027, Active, lead 26 weeks (2026-09-28T15:34:31Z). TI page https://www.ti.com/product/REF2030: REF20 ACTIVE, REF2030AIDDCR ACTIVE (2026-09-28T15:40:18Z). First data sheet revision July 2018. The rule-5 second source is Digi-Key stock over the 50 gate.

Grade not considered. This is the A grade of P2's shortlisted rank-5 LM4040BIM3-3.0/NOPB: same data sheet, same SOT-23 footprint, same series-resistor circuit. SNOS633N, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lm4040-n.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:35:57Z, section 5.11. The reverse breakdown tolerance at IR 100 uA is +/-3 mV at 25 degC and +/-22 mV over TMIN to TMAX (-40 to 85 degC). The B grade is +/-6 mV and +/-26 mV. The A grade's worst case is 2.978 V against the 2.97 V floor, where the B grade's is 2.974 V. Wideband noise 35 uVrms (10 Hz to 10 kHz). The ADC_AVDD draw plus IRMIN (67 uA max over temperature) sets the series resistor, as for the B grade. Stock and status: JLCPCB stockCount 2,969, canPresaleNumber 2,954, 1.6126 USD at 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C544506, 2026-09-28T15:33:42Z). Digi-Key 26,708, Active, lead 9 weeks (2026-09-28T15:34:33Z). TI page https://www.ti.com/product/LM4040-N: LM4040-N ACTIVE, LM4040AIM3-3.0/NOPB ACTIVE (2026-09-28T15:40:20Z). The C9409 LM4040A30IDBZR that P2 dropped for stock is a different orderable of this grade.

Weakness, sourcing: JLCPCB stockCount 129, canPresaleNumber 128, 21.9556 USD at 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C514243, 2026-09-28T15:33:24Z). Digi-Key 0 in stock, Active, lead 48 weeks (2026-09-28T15:34:38Z). No second vendor passes rule 5, and no pin- and firmware-compatible 16-bit alternate was found. Lifecycle is from Digi-Key (ADI rule): Active.

missed.maker: Microchip Technology (JLCPCB label 'Microchip Tech'); S1 Microchip
missed.why: Family not considered: delta-sigma with an external clock input, a different architecture from the ADS131M02 P2 dropped. Data sheet DS20006404C (Revision C, April 2021; Revision A August 2020), https://ww1.microchip.com/downloads/aemDocuments/documents/APID/ProductDocuments/DataSheets/MCP3461-2-4R-Family-Data-Sheet-DS20006404C.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:39:53Z. 16-bit, data rate up to 153.6 ksps. Gain 0.33x to 64x. Input pin range AGND - 0.1 V to AVDD + 0.1 V, and differential range +/-VREF/Gain. With VREF = AVDD, or the internal 2.4 V +/-2 % reference at gain 0.33x, 0.33 to 2.97 V fits without a divider. P2 dropped the ADS131M02 for the lack of exactly that range. SINAD 96.9 dB min at AVDD = DVDD = VREF = 3.3 V, 25 degC, MCLK 4.9152 MHz, default register settings, 50 Hz input. AVDD 2.7 to 3.6 V and DVDD 1.8 V to AVDD + 0.1 V, so it runs from the 3.3 V rail at 3.3 V logic. Internal oscillator or external clock on MCLK (Features), so the coprocessor can clock it. A conversion start pulse is 1 DMCLK; data ready is on IRQ. The latency jitter figure Q4 asks for is not stated in the data sheet and was not derived. -40 to 125 degC. Stock and status: JLCPCB stockCount 267, canPresaleNumber 262, 6.0135 USD at 1 (vendors.py jlcpcb C5227392, 2026-09-28T15:33:34Z). Digi-Key 5,822, Active, lead 8 weeks (2026-09-28T15:34:44Z). Microchip page https://www.microchip.com/en-us/product/MCP3461R: 'Status: In Production' (2026-09-28T15:39:43Z). An errata sheet, DS20007131 (MCP3X6XR Silicon Errata), is listed on that page; it was not read.

exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The P2 row of Research.md drops a candidate only when it misses a requirement value. Five is the number of survivors P2 records in full, not a reason to drop one. These were dropped unread while the rank-5 LM4040B, with the least margin (2.974 V), was kept. REF3430 figures: data sheet SBAS804G, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ref34.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:35:49Z. Accuracy -0.05 % to +0.05 % at 25 degC. TC 6 ppm/degC max over -40 to 125 degC. Noise 24 uVrms (10 Hz to 10 kHz). IQ 95 uA max. VIN is VOUT + VDO to 12 V, with VDO 100 mV max at 0 mA and 500 mV max at 10 mA. So the 5 V rail meets it, and the 3.3 V rail's 3.201 V is not covered by a stated figure at the 0.18 mA load. That is better than the shortlisted REF3033 (+/-0.2 %, 75 ppm/degC per jlcparts) on the same 5 V rail, though at 3.0 V rather than 3.3 V. The pinout GND_F, GND_S, EN, IN, OUT_S, OUT_F (SOT-23-6) matches the ADR3430's (Rev. C, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ADR3412_ADR3420_ADR3425_ADR3430_ADR3433_ADR3440_ADR3450.pdf, read 2026-09-28T15:37:17Z, Table 12). The ADR3430 (JLCPCB 8,178, presale 8,161, 2026-09-28T15:33:50Z) is therefore a rule-5 alternate. That matters because the REF3430 has Digi-Key 0, Active, lead 16 weeks (2026-09-28T15:34:48Z). JLCPCB REF3430IDBVR stockCount 1,017, canPresaleNumber 988, 1.9033 USD at 1 (2026-09-28T15:33:55Z). The other parts of the group were not qualified here: REF3330AIDBZR JLCPCB 5,266, presale 5,140 (15:33:57Z); REF5030AIDR 10,801, presale 10,704 (15:34:00Z); MCP1501T-30E/CHY 56, presale 44 (15:33:58Z). Side note: P2's ADR3430 reason reverses the arithmetic. The rail's 3.201 V is 1 mV above the part's 3.2 V minimum, not below it. Its dropout of 200 mV max at 0 mA and 250 mV max at 2 mA (Rev. C Table 6) is what puts it on the 5 V rail, so that conclusion stands.
